currency_assumptions: Costs retain their published local amount and ISO code: SGD where the venue publishes SGD (all recorded Singapore venues publish SGD or quote-based).

SGD-to-USD conversion: European Central Bank euro foreign exchange reference rates, retrieved 2026-08-10 (ECB daily feed, https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/eurofxref-daily.xml): EUR 1 = USD 1.1555 and EUR 1 = SGD 1.4785, therefore USD 1 = SGD 1.27953 (computed 1.4785 / 1.1555) and 1 SGD = USD 0.78153534. This is a documented, date-stamped source rate; it is a planning conversion, not a bank/venue quote.

All USD estimates are derived 8-hour or published-rate calculations labeled in evidence.inference and rate_estimate_note; GST is included where the page states it (Tagvenue pages state 'All prices include GST'; LLI rates state w/GST columns), and any taxes/fees/AV extras not shown on the page remain verification questions.
